title: The French Bulldog Ended A 31-Year Reign
hook: America quietly changed its favorite dog.
source: American Kennel Club annual breed registration statistics -- French Bulldog vs. Labrador Retriever, new registrations per year. 2022-2023 figures as reported by AKC (French Bulldog 108,000 then 98,500, taking #1 from the Labrador after 31 years); earlier years approximate as publicly reported.
